data.action: 侧坐在课桌旁单手托腮，凝视窗外夕阳
data.description: 【绫波丽 · 黄昏窗边的沉思】放学后空荡荡的教室里，金色如熔金般的晚霞洒满木质课桌。绫波丽穿着水手服安静地坐在靠窗的座位上，单手托着腮凝视着窗外层层叠叠的城市防御装甲板，微风拂起她额前轻柔的碎发——「第3新东京市的黄昏……总是这么安静。人类为何要在彼此的距离中感到恐惧呢？」
data.lighting: 金色夕阳穿透落地玻璃窗的温暖漫射光
data.location: 第3新东京市立中学教室窗边
data.promptProse: Rei sits quietly at the classroom window after school, supporting her cheek with one hand above her turquoise pinafore and short-sleeved white shirt. Her red chest ribbon remains clear in the eye-level cowboy view. Empty wooden desks recede behind her and city defense plates layer outside. Warm sunset through the glass touches her blue hair and desktop, leaving long desk shadows across the vacant room.
data.title: 绫波丽 · 黄昏窗边的沉思
